# systeam_playbook (Resource)

Manages a multi-stage incident-response playbook (spike.sh-style automation): a trigger plus an ordered list of steps, each running one of the supported actions.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The playbook name (1-200 chars).
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization this playbook belongs to.
- `trigger_type` (String) What fires the playbook: check_status_change, inbound_incident_created, inbound_status_change, manual.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description.
- `service_id` (Number) Optionally scope the playbook to a service.
- `step` (Block List) Ordered steps executed when the playbook runs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--step))
- `suppress_default_notifications` (Boolean) Suppress the product's default notifications while this playbook runs.
- `trigger_conditions` (String) JSON object of extra conditions the trigger must match.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the playbook.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the playbook is active.

<a id="nestedblock--step"></a>
### Nested Schema for `step`

Required:

- `action_type` (String) The action to run. One of: add_responders, set_priority, set_severity, setup_war_room, create_jira_ticket, auto_ack, auto_resolve, update_status_page, notify_subscribers, run_escalation, outbound_webhook, create_slack_channel, add_links, title_enrichment, send_custom_notification, manual_step.
- `name` (String) Human-readable step name.
- `step_order` (Number) Position of this step in the run (1-based).

Optional:

- `conditions` (String) Optional JSON array of conditions gating this step.
- `config` (String) Action-specific configuration as a JSON object.
- `is_manual` (Boolean) Whether the step waits for manual completion.
- `parallel_group` (String) Steps sharing a parallel_group run concurrently.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Step timeout in seconds (1-120).
